_note: Fill every FILL_ME in. The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 require a seller to publish its legal name, address, customer-care contact and a grievance officer. The privacy and contact pages render from this file, and the server warns on startup while anything is unfilled.
legalName: FILL_ME — the registered name, e.g. Moteeka Jewellery Pvt Ltd or your own name if a sole proprietorship
address: FILL_ME — full postal address including PIN code
_deliveryNote: How long a customer waits, stated everywhere it is stated: the product page, the footer and the delivery fold all read these two numbers. The Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020 require the delivery timeline to be published, and a timeline a buyer finds out about only after ordering is where disputes and chargebacks come from.
policyUpdated: FILL_ME — the date you publish, e.g. 2026-09-13
